subject: chem
title: Chemical Bonding
subtitle: Chemical Bonding with core theory, reaction logic, and exam-focused application.
concept: Chemical bonding is driven by electrostatic attraction and lowering of total energy. Atoms arrange electrons to achieve more stable electronic structures.

Different bonding types explain contrasting material properties. Ionic solids are brittle and high-melting because of giant ionic lattices, while simple molecular substances are usually low-melting due to weaker intermolecular forces.
Exam questions often join structure, bonding, and properties. The strongest answers explicitly connect bonding model to physical behavior such as conductivity, boiling point, or solubility.
